capabilities: browse a property → value → note tree with typed value rows and type icons
filter, sort, pin, and hide properties, and save selections as named views
search property names, values, and note names or paths within chosen scopes
bulk rename, merge, convert to wikilink, or split values after reviewing a per-note preview
undo the last bulk edit and open or copy native Search queries for a property or value
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later; desktop and mobile supported. Bulk edits only touch frontmatter; the YAML writer may reformat comments and quoting. Undo is in-memory and cleared on restart or reload.
intentEvidence: turns your vault's YAML frontmatter into a full-pane, browsable tree of properties → values → notes
problem: Obsidian's properties view works per-note, so there is no built-in way to see how metadata is used vault-wide or change a property value in many notes at once.

relations.evidence: The core Search plugin is required only for the "Open in Search" action.

summary: Property explorer that turns vault frontmatter into a browsable tree of properties, values, and notes, with previewed bulk edits and undo.
